header_summary:
A novel protocol synthesizing elements from existing consensus mechanisms has been proposed to enable soft-agreement in the Bitcoin mempool, significantly improving block propagation speed and optimizing transaction processing. By facilitating batch agreement on groups of transactions, the protocol aims to streamline block formation and minimize redundancies, as detailed in the original research paper ([source](https://beige-worrying-unicorn-969.mypinata.cloud/ipfs/bafybeigsbdid4znwtmoqh55yid2etxkujci33dzqt3ia6bt5vwsnllfqym), [discussion](https://delvingbitcoin.org/t/snowball-to-snowstorm/3014)).

Recent comparative experiments by Aaron van Wirdum and collaborators evaluated state channel implementations using APO+CTV, CSFS+CTV ladder, and the latest TEMPLATEHASH+CSFS+INTERNALKEY approach. The latest configuration demonstrated reduced script complexity, smaller update leaf size, and a constant witness size, with source code and transaction details provided for reproducibility ([analysis](https://delvingbitcoin.org/t/eltoo-state-chain-on-signet-third-time-templatehash-csfs-internalkey/3012)).

The Bitcoin development mailing list archive has introduced a redesigned "Years" navigation, offering chronological access to threads since 2011, streamlined month-based navigation, and a more intuitive interface, enhancing the accessibility and usability of historical discussions ([announcement](https://delvingbitcoin.org/t/we-made-the-bitcoin-dev-mailing-list-readable-15-years-24-699-messages/2985/3)).

recent_posts.title: Snowball to Snowstorm
recent_posts.summary:
- A new protocol enables soft-agreement within the Bitcoin mempool before block discovery.
- This system synchronizes network participants on groups of transactions using consensus techniques like the Snowball protocol.
- Improved coordination reduces redundancies, streamlining block formation and accelerating block propagation network-wide.

recent_posts.title: Eltoo state chain on signet, third time: TEMPLATEHASH + CSFS + INTERNALKEY
recent_posts.summary: - Three update methods differ in transaction count, witness size, and update script complexity.  - TEMPLATEHASH enables smaller scripts and more flexible validation by exposing computed hashes to the stack.  - The demonstration, not production-ready, uses simple scripts to highlight fundamental eltoo channel mechanics.

recent_posts.title: We made the bitcoin-dev mailing list readable: 15 years, 24,699 messages
recent_posts.summary: - The archive features a "Years" navigation section, listing years since 2011 and thread counts.  - Year pages group threads by month, include direct month links, and enable efficient date-based browsing.  - The homepage now shows a “Recently active” list and improved navigation labels for better clarity.

active_posts.title: Stats on compact block reconstructions
active_posts.summary: - Compact block reconstruction efficiency depends on transaction availability, mempool activity, and node configuration changes.  - Node policies, such as enabling mempoolfullrbf, can significantly improve network-wide block reconstruction times.  - Further investigation explores bandwidth, extra pool sizes, and node connection types' influence on reconstruction performance.

active_posts.title: Public key recovery for EC leaves in P2MR (BIP-360)
active_posts.summary: - A recoverable EC leaf enables public key recovery from signatures to minimize witness size in P2MR.  - The approach uses the Merkle root hash in the signature challenge, preventing related-key cryptographic attacks.  - New validation logic requires streamlined witness structures, contributing to blockchain space and transaction cost savings.

active_posts.title: What is the importance of running a node?
active_posts.summary: - There is significant debate about the necessity and benefits of individuals running network nodes.  - Critics question whether operating a node truly improves personal security or offers substantial advantages.  - Practical barriers and unclear incentives discourage widespread participation, leaving the issue largely unresolved.

today_in_history_posts.title: BIP- & SLIP-0039 -- better multi-language support
today_in_history_posts.summary: - BIP-0039's language dependence restricts users who select non-English mnemonic codes to that language.  - SLIP-0039 offers only an English wordlist, which can disadvantage non-English speakers.  - Guo suggests supporting decimal representations and translation tools to improve accessibility and flexibility.

today_in_history_posts.title: Wireshark plug-in for Lightning Network(BOLT) protocol
today_in_history_posts.summary: - Nayuta team is developing a Wireshark plug-in to decode Lightning Network BOLT messages.  - The plug-in currently supports ptarmigan and Éclair, utilizing key information or log files.  - The proposal seeks standardized communication logs in .pcap format for easier interoperability testing.

today_in_history_posts.title: Libbitcoin for Core people
today_in_history_posts.summary: - Libbitcoin achieves up to fifteen times faster IBD than Bitcoin Core using distinct asynchronous operations.  - Its relational database and parallel block validation optimize sequencing and significantly boost processing efficiency.  - Features include event-driven tasks, flexible transaction handling, and dynamic peer management, while pruning is unimplemented.
